positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: What establishes the Pallasine checklist as the current, authoritative onboarding process?
positions.why: src-1 states the checklist as a universal, unnegotiated mandate for every new hire (authority-ranking, legitimate power, decision-grade conviction) naming its three components; src-2 supplies the historical warrant for that standing — it displaced the prior wiki-page system last quarter. Read together, the two expressions trace how the checklist derives its current authority: not just what it requires, but why it is the operative process rather than a residual or competing one. No tension between the two — src-2 corroborates rather than complicates src-1's mandate framing, though the conviction register differs (decision vs. flat factual claim).
